lead: Pětiprstá dlaň se 17 stupni volnosti: 16 kloubů v prstech a jeden v zápěstí. Prsty táhnou šlachy vedené v PTFE trubičkách od cívek na servech, která jsou ve věži pod zápěstím. Projekt podporuje serva Dynamixel i Feetech. Kůži prstů a dlaně odlijete ze silikonu do tištěných forem, nebo ji rychleji vytisknete z TPU. Varianta Touch má ve špičkách prstů hmatové senzory. Ovládá se z Pythonu knihovnou orca_core.

en.credit: Render from the ORCA Dexterity model (CC BY 4.0)
en.alt: ORCA Hand five-finger robot hand on a tower of servos
en.short: Five-finger hand with 17 degrees of freedom, driven by tendons from servos in a tower below the wrist.
en.lead: Five-finger hand with 17 degrees of freedom: 16 finger joints and one in the wrist. The fingers are pulled by tendons running through PTFE tubes from spools on the servos, which sit in a tower below the wrist. The project supports both Dynamixel and Feetech servos. You cast the finger and palm skin in silicone using printed molds, or print it faster in TPU. The Touch variant has tactile sensors in the fingertips. It is controlled from Python with the orca_core library.
